sn22.102:1.2: Aniccasaññā bhikkhave bhāvitā bahulīkatā sabbaṃ kāmarāgam pariyādiyati sabbaṃ rūparāgam pariyādiyati sabbaṃ bhavarāgam pariyādiyati sabbam avijjam pariyādiyati || sabbam asmimānam pariyādiyati samūhanti || || 4
sn22.102:2.1: Seyyathāpi bhikkhave saradasamaye kasako mahānaṅgalena kasanto sabbāni mūlasantānakāni sampadālento kasati || ||
sn22.102:2.2: Evam eva kho bhikkhave aniccasaññā bhāvitā bahulīkatā sabbaṃ kāmarāgam pariyādiyati || sabbaṃ rūparāgam pariyādiyati || sabbam bhavarāgam pariyādiyati || sabbam avijjam pariyādiyati || sabbam asmimānaṃ samūhanti || || 5
sn22.102:3.1: Seyyathāpi bhikkhave pabbajalāyako pabbajaṃ lāyitvā agge gahetvā odhunāti niddhunāti nicchodeti ||
sn22.102:3.2: Evam eva kho bhikkhave aniccasaññā bhāvitā || pe || 6
sn22.102:4.1: Seyyathāpi bhikkhave ambapiṇḍiyā vaṇṭacchinnāya yāni tatra ambāni vaṇṭapaṭibaddhāni sabbāni tāni tadanvayāni bhavanti ||
sn22.102:4.2: evam eva kho bhikkhave aniccasaññā bhāvitā || pa || 7
sn22.102:5.1: Seyyathāpi bhikkhave kūṭāgārassa yā kāci gopānasiyo sabbā tā kūṭaṅgamā kūṭaninnā kūṭasamosaraṇā kūṭaṃ tāsam aggam akkhāyati || ||
sn22.102:5.2: evam eva kho bhikkhave aniccasaññā bhāvitā || pa || || 8
sn22.102:6.1: Seyyathāpi bhikkhave ye keci mūlagandhā kāḷānusārī tesam aggam akkhāyati ||
sn22.102:6.2: evam eva kho bhikkhave aniccasaññā || pa || 9
sn22.102:7.1: Seyyathāpi bhikkhave ye keci sāragandhā lohitacandanaṃ tesam aggam akkhāyati ||
sn22.102:7.2: evam eva kho bhikkhave aniccasaññā || pa || 10
sn22.102:8.1: Seyyathāpi bhikkhave ye keci pupphagandhā vassikaṃ tesam aggam akkhāyati ||
sn22.102:8.2: evam eva kho bhikkhave aniccasaññā || pa || 11
sn22.102:9.1: Seyyathāpi bhikkhave ye keci kuḍḍarājāno sabbe te rañño cakkavattissa anuyantā bhavanti || rājā tesaṃ cakkavatti aggam akkhāyati ||
sn22.102:9.2: evam eva kho bhikkhave aniccasaññā || pe || 12
sn22.102:10.1: Seyyathāpi bhikkhave yā kāci tārakarūpānam pabhā sabbā tā candimapabhāya kalaṃ nāgghanti solasiṃ candappabhā tāsam aggam akkhāyati ||
sn22.102:10.2: evam eva kho bhikkhave aniccasaññā || pa || || 13
sn22.102:11.1: Seyyathāpi bhikkhave saradasamaye viddhe vigatavalāhake deve ādicco nabham abbhussukkamāno sabbam ākāsagatam tamagatam abhivihacca bhāsate ca tapate ca virocati ca ||
sn22.102:11.2: evam eva kho bhikkhave aniccasaññā bhāvitā bahulīkatā sabbaṃ kāmarāgam pariyādiyati || sabbaṃ rūparāgam pariyādiyati || sabbam bhavarāgam pariyādiyati || sabbam avijjam pariyādiyati || sabbam asmimānaṃ samūhanti || || 14
sn22.102:12.1: Katham bhavitā ca bhikkhave aniccasaññā katham bahulīkatā sabbaṃ kāmarāgam pariyādiyati || pe || sabbam asmimānam samūhanti || || 15
sn22.102:12.2: Iti rūpam iti rūpassa samudayo iti rūpassa atthagamo || ||
sn22.102:12.6: Iti viññāṇam iti viññāṇassa samudayo iti viññāṇassa atthagamo ti || || 16
sn22.102:12.7: Evam bhāvitā kho bhikkhave aniccasaññā evam bahulīkatā sabbaṃ kāmarāgam pariyādiyati || sabbaṃ rūparāgam pariyādiyati || sabbam bhavarāgam pariyādiyati || sabbam avijjam pariyādiyati || sabbam asmimānaṃ samūhantīti || ||
sn22.102:13.4: Vāsijaṭam Aniccatā ti || Vaggo Majjhimapaññāsako samatto || ||
sn22.102:14.4: tena vuccati || || 1-2 Sāvatthi || || Tatra || voca || || 3 Cattāro me
